title: X.js: A Live Benchmark for Node.js Taint-Style Vulnerabilities
abstract: arXiv:2610.18585v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: JavaScript vulnerabilities in npm packages pose a significant risk to the Node$.$js ecosystem, and a growing body of work aims to detect, exploit, and mitigate them. Studying and evaluating this work requires up-to-date collections of real vulnerabilities, yet the most commonly used datasets stop recording vulnerabilities in 2022. We present X$.$js, a live benchmark of real-world Node$.$js taint-style vulnerabilities covering code and command injection, prototype pollution, and path traversal. Built from 1,738 advisories collected through mid-2026, primarily from the GitHub Advisory Database, X$.$js pairs each vulnerability with precise source and sink locations, a validated executable exploit and its execution trace, and, when available, a patched version of the package. X$.$js supports long-term reproducibility and growth: dependencies are mirrored in a self-hosted registry to guard against package removal from the ecosystem,

translated_title: X.js：一个Node.js污点风格漏洞的动态基准测试集
translated_abstract: npm包中的JavaScript漏洞对Node.js生态系统构成重大风险，越来越多的研究工作旨在检测、利用和缓解这些漏洞。对这类工作进行研究和评估需要最新的真实漏洞集合，然而最常用的数据集在2022年就停止记录漏洞了。我们提出了X.js，这是一个真实世界Node.js污点风格漏洞的动态（持续更新的）基准测试集，涵盖代码和命令注入、原型污染以及路径遍历等漏洞类型。X.js基于截至2026年中期收集的1,738份安全公告（主要来自GitHub咨询数据库）构建，将每个漏洞与精确的源（source）和汇（sink）位置、经过验证的可执行漏洞利用程序及其执行轨迹，以及在可用情况下的包修补版本进行配对。X.js支持长期可复现性和持续增长：依赖项被镜像到自托管注册表中，以防止包从生态系统中被移除。
tldr: 本文提出了X.js——一个持续更新的真实世界Node.js污点风格漏洞基准测试集，每个漏洞均配有精确的源汇位置、经验证的可执行漏洞利用程序及补丁版本，解决了现有漏洞数据集过时、无法支持该领域研究长期发展的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents X.js, a live benchmark of real-world Node.js taint-style vulnerabilities that pairs each vulnerability with precise source/sink locations, validated executable exploits, and patched package versions, addressing the outdatedness of existing vulnerability datasets.
